name: Dürr Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Dürr Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a mechanical and plant engineering company worldwide. It operates through Automotive, Industrial Automation, and Woodworking segments. The company plans, builds, and updates paint shops and final assembly lines for the automotive industry.
